# Job Board Spec (`job-board-v2.html`, generated by `board_gen_v2.py`)

Why this file exists: without a written contract the board's layout changed four times in one day
and nobody could say what was supposed to be on the page. This file is the contract.
`verify_board.py` (invariant F) checks `board_gen_v2.py` against the view list below and checks
that lane files come from `profile.json`, and blocks the board if either drifts. **Changing
anything here requires the owner's OK in chat; then the change is logged at the bottom with the date.**

## Principles
- One state per row. Action views carry decision columns; audit views add the evidence columns.
- The board is THE tracker: every built resume and every application is visible here.
- Nothing personal is hard-coded: the page title (`board.title`), lane resume files
  (`lanes.TAC/STRAT.generalResume`), built-resume file names (`person.fileNamePrefix`), pay tiers
  (`pay.tiers`), local markets (`search.localMarkets`), converted currencies (`pay.currencies`) and
  the staffing-flag list (`board.staffingFlagRegex`) come from `profile.json`.

## Views (buttons), exactly these, in this order
SEND BUILT, TO TAILOR, MAYBE, GENERAL, EZ QUEUE, QUEUE, UNSCORED, MY SKIPS, APPLIED, ALL.

Only SEND BUILT / TO TAILOR / MAYBE / GENERAL render as primary buttons; EZ QUEUE, QUEUE, UNSCORED,
MY SKIPS, APPLIED and ALL sit behind a dim "audit" toggle, hidden by default. Audit views show the
evidence columns.

## State vocabulary (one per row)
| State | Meaning |
|---|---|
| SEND | a resume is built and not yet sent (file in RESUME); also NEEDS-YOU / VERIFY calls |
| TAILOR | worth a custom build (an Easy Apply row that deserves one is TAILOR here AND saved on LinkedIn) |
| MAYBE | one named gap, written in WHY; the owner decides |
| GENERAL | worth applying with the lane's General resume, external apply (the pool value stays call=GENERIC) |
| EZ | MAYBE/GENERAL rows that are Easy Apply: processed from LinkedIn Saved, tracked here (audit view) |
| QUEUE | machine-flagged rows awaiting workplace verification and the reader pass |
| UNSCORED | no machine verdict; must trend to and stay at 0 (score-at-birth) |
| MYSKIP | the reader or the classifier said no |
| APPLIED | applied (tracker, board-state, or a tick) |
| CLOSED | GONE, or tracked as closed before applying (shown in the APPLIED view) |

Priority when several apply: applied/closed > built > the reader's call > the machine verdict.

## Columns, in this order
| # | Header | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | ✓ | applied tick (browser localStorage; "save ticks for Claude" exports it) |
| 2 | ✗ | toss tick |
| 3 | ⊘ | closed tick ("no longer accepting"): ingest_state marks the row GONE and puts it on watch |
| 4 | title | link to the posting |
| 5 | company | |
| 6 | comp | pay text from the comp field, then the tags below |
| 7 | RESUME | the file to send: a built resume, or the lane's General |
| 8 | WHY | the reader's reason (`callWhy`), or the machine why for QUEUE/UNSCORED |
| 9-12 | bucket, verdict, fit, workplace | audit columns (classifier bucket, JD verdict, JD score, workplace) |

## Tags (in the comp cell)
- **EASY**: Easy Apply.
- **STAFF**: consultancy, staffing agency or reposter (`board.staffingFlagRegex`). Informational
  only; never changes calls, lanes or states. Real companies sort before STAFF rows in every view.
- **Local market** (e.g. `CODE HYBRID`, `CODE ONSITE`): rows in a `search.localMarkets` place,
  where hybrid or onsite is allowed. Plain HYBRID/ONSITE rows are not rendered.
- **P1 / P2 / P3** on SEND and TAILOR rows: pay tier from the comp FIELD against `pay.tiers` for
  the row's region (US tiers when the region has none). Hourly bands count 2,000 hours a year;
  converted currencies (`pay.currencies` with a rate or monthly rule) tier as annual EUR. The
  legend prints the US thresholds.
- **J1 / J2 / J3** on SEND, TAILOR, MAYBE, GENERAL, EZ and QUEUE rows: how well the Career Bank
  covers the JD's requirements (`sweep_lib.jd_match`, computed at render); hover shows the matched
  share, the gaps and the unmatched lines.
- **M**: the reader judged the company mission-driven; hover shows the reason.

## Visibility
- Tossed rows are filtered out.
- ONSITE/HYBRID rows are not rendered except SEND rows; local-market tokens are not plain
  ONSITE/HYBRID and do render.
- GONE renders as CLOSED.
- Built-unsent tracker roles with no pool row render as synthetic SEND rows ("BUILT (no pool
  row)"), never when the id is already applied.

## Filters and sort
- region: ALL (default) / US / EU.
- search box matches title, company and WHY.
- Default order inside every view: state, then real companies before STAFF, then Easy Apply first,
  then best pay first, then company.
- Sort buttons reorder any view client-side: pay (default), fit (J), mission (M), best overlap
  (count of P1, J1 and M).

## Header
The measured scoreboard: last sweep (batch, date, keyword count, region, workplace), ticks import,
watch count, UNSCORED live (must be 0), EZ saved on LinkedIn.

## Change log
- kit v1.0: contract written for the kit; every personal value read from `profile.json`;
  verify_board invariant F checks that lane files come from the profile instead of a file-name literal.
